title: Kissed Japanese Savoury Leaves Dorayaki
description: A nutty, aerated dorayaki that blends puffed rice, protein powder, and char‑grilled summer savoury leaves for a high‑protein, one‑pot lunch.

ingredients.name: Dried summer savoury leaves
ingredients.notes: Rehydrate in warm water for 5 min, then squeeze dry

instructions: Heat the skillet on the Lazy Susan spinner over medium heat and lightly coat with vegetable oil.
Whisk the eggs, protein powder, gluten‑free flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl until smooth.
Stir in the puffed rice cereal and char‑grill‑yang sauce until the mixture is evenly combined.
Fold in the rehydrated summer savoury leaves until evenly distributed.
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet, spreading it into a circle about 4 inches in diameter.
Cook for 3–4 minutes until the edges lift, then flip carefully and cook the other side for another 3 minutes.
Repeat with remaining batter, allowing the skillet to heat between batches.
Transfer cooked dorayakis to a plate, garnish with minced green onion, and serve warm.
